reviews.text:
Best cat and dog clinic in Montreal. The reception staff is incredibly patient. They are welcoming and know how to understand and positively address clients' needs.

The highly skilled technician is dedicated to taking precise notes to understand the animal's current condition, habits, pedigree, and behavioral changes, which guides the vet's analysis. Smiling, she provides hygiene care and offers helpful tips for home care.

Dr. Bouchard is extremely professional in analyzing and examining your pet. It's clear she works with animal health in mind. Open-minded, she listens to your concerns and suggests a suitable course of action and treatment for your pet, not just a cost-cutting measure. I highly recommend this clean and modern clinic.

I went for my 16-year-old cat, Zazou, who is experiencing stress, among other things, due to the introduction of another feline, Pinotte. A little Tasmanian devil with a heart of gold.

The best experience my pet and I have ever had. The price of vaccinations is more than reasonable, including the rabies vaccine for cats that go outside.

Zazou says: Thank you team!
They took good care of my Gaia!
Excellent service, thank you to Joëlle for her excellent support!

Friendly and very professional staff.
The explanations provided by the veterinarian and assistants were clear and detailed.

The care was excellent, as usual. I like the new layout of the room, which allows for some separation between the waiting animals. There was no pressure, but they clearly explained the recommendations for the best care for our pet.

I attended the HOMA veterinary clinic's open house and was very impressed. The facilities are modern and well-designed, and the team was professional, welcoming, and attentive. You can tell that animal welfare is at the heart of their approach. I highly recommend them!
It was my little cat Greta's first time with a vet for her vaccinations. A very humane approach, a relaxing environment, excellent care, very happy ☺️

The staff are caring, patient, and competent, and you can genuinely feel that the well-being of our animals is a priority. I particularly appreciated the follow-up phone call after the procedure, as well as their honesty and transparency regarding the care that was truly needed, without recommending unnecessary interventions.
Excellent service.

Launch on the 17th... and their voicemail just leaves a swirling void of: "We didn't get your response." I don't have an appointment, but... my cat needs a nail trim.
Renovations almost finished, new layout... New staff too, I think; someone should activate the remote to open the outside door. Logically, when that same person ends the current call, they demonstrate that their attention is available... ... ..🤨 Two employees glued to their computer screens, neither seems available.
I thought it was a good time to test things out, so I replied to the email, received the day before, confirming my cat's appointment... "I'm here but don't know who to ask. You know, plastic and screens...". A good 3 minutes later, I was called over by the one facing the front door 😳🤭✌️😇. The old premises didn't make the employees any friendlier... And it's not about masks! And affordable housing requires renovations.
The staff is very professional.

We came in for our dog's vaccinations and everything went very well. The reception staff are always lovely, and the vet who saw Una for her vaccinations was very friendly, gentle, and professional :) Thank you for everything :)
Thank you for your feedback!
Personalized service, where each professional took the time to explain and rephrase everything clearly. Furthermore, the care provided to our baby was very professional and caring.
Thank you for taking the time to rate us!

Despite the fees, which we always find too high (but no more so than elsewhere!), I was advised to only pay for what was necessary to get a diagnosis. The staff is incredibly kind, and you can tell our pet is loved!

Very professional, and they explained the steps of my kitten's spaying procedure very clearly. Thank you to the technician who took care of Mielly the morning of her spaying. She was gentle, kind, and smiling. I was happy when she told me how Mielly's day had gone when we picked her up. It was also kind of her to call me the day after her surgery to ask how she was doing.
Great clinic and vets who love animals. I'm so glad I found this clinic. Excellent service and very kind staff.

This clinic use to be amazing. The staff were dedicated, the service was excellent, and the prices were reasonable. Unfortunately, after the clinic grew, the quality of service went downhill dramatically.

I was told I might have to wait six months to a year for my cat's echo. Another clinic performed it just four days after I called. That alone says a lot.

The results were sent to this clinic, yet I was asked to bring my cat back just to receive them. The experience felt more like a money grab than genuine concern for my pet, so I transferred his care to Hopital Veterinaire de l'Est, where the staff have been professional and helpful.

The reason I'm writing this review now is that, a year later, I received and appointment scheduled for the echo that they had original requested. The appointment was not only a year too late, but also for a heart echo, even though my concern involved my cat's stomach. The problem was his stomach. This outdate and inaccurate follow-up is concerning.

It is disappointing to see how far this clinic has fallen. Growth should never come at the expense of patient care.

This is my third visit to this clinic, and I've been well received with my two senior cats (one of whom has diabetes and chronic kidney disease). The veterinarians I've seen are very empathetic and take the time to explain things thoroughly. I highly recommend this clinic.

I would like to thank Dr. Santina Cardellini who, during our appointment on October 6th, took the time to thoroughly explain the situation and the available options. Thanks to her clear explanations and attentive listening, I was able to make an informed decision regarding my cat Marley's recurring condition.
Highly professional service.
The technician was well received by Jenny. Jenny hated being touched. I had to hold her (gently) so the vet could examine her.

A perfect veterinarian. She possesses all the qualities one could hope to find in a vet entrusted with the care of their cat. Dr. Audre-Legault is a very caring veterinarian, and we are absolutely delighted with the way she takes care of our cat, who suffers from allergies.

We received excellent service at the clinic. Dr. Papillon and the technician, Frédérique, were very kind, attentive, and gentle with my cat.
The examination was very thorough: they took the time to carefully check his eyes, heart, mouth, abdomen, and overall condition. A problem with his thyroid gland was quickly identified, and the situation and the next steps were clearly explained to me.
I particularly appreciated being presented with three treatment options, along with the associated costs, so I could make an informed decision based on my cat and my situation. I was also able to ask several questions about his health and receive clear answers.
I felt well supported throughout the consultation. Thank you to Frédérique and Dr. Papillon for their kindness and professionalism.
Everything went well for my cats; I dealt with Dr. Audet-Legault and Dr. Papillon a few years ago, and in both cases I found them kind, attentive, empathetic, and of course, competent.

The technician and vet were super caring and informative. The appointment was not delayed, making the experience less stressful for our pet. We really appreciate the professionalism and care the clinic provides, especially Dre Marie-Gabrielle Bouchard and the technician who assisted her during our visit.
Thank you for your feedback!

My previous veterinary clinic was acquired by a large group, and the quality of service and care declined, so I decided to switch clinics. After some research, HoMa Clinic stood out.

I'm really happy with my first visit to the clinic. Everyone was very welcoming and competent. From the receptionist to the technician and the veterinarian, everyone was very friendly. The examination and vaccination of my cats went very well, and the advice and explanations I received were very clear.

I really appreciated this first visit. It reassured me that there are still veterinary practices that don't treat their clients/patients like walking cash cows.

I've already recommended the clinic to friends!

They always demonstrate a very kind and empathetic approach to my animals, providing attentive and patient care. The entire team is very professional, friendly, and sensitive, and open to adapting to the individual needs of both the animal and its owner. Overall, all my visits have gone very well.

The staff were courteous and friendly, and Toby felt comfortable. I don't have their names, but everyone was great, from the receptionist to the technicians and veterinarians. I was well-informed, and they treated me and my dog ​​with respect.
Excellent service, fast and courteous, and truly professional.

The staff is great, very warm and welcoming and I feel my pets are well taken care of. But one thing that pisses me off is that this clinic don’t respect our time. Every single appointment is ALWAYS delayed by 30-60min, whether it’s at 10am or 4pm, whether it’s with the vet or the technician. I was with other 4 people in the waiting room, and we were all in the same boat. And it’s always the same excuse “we had many complicated cases today”. If you always have complicated cases no matter the time, could you then take less appointments please? It’s sad but having to wait like this wipes off all the great work from the staff.
Thank you for your feedback!

I am very satisfied with the attentive care given to my pet (Romi), the professionalism and the explanations offered to help me understand the situation my cat was experiencing :) I recommend this clinic without hesitation!
Very nice clinic. The staff is great and very friendly.

The staff is incredibly attentive. They take their time and provide clear answers to the issues discussed, outlining all possible options and the consequences of each choice. I am satisfied with the care provided overall. It's a great environment for both animals and their owners.
What strikes me is the kindness of both the veterinarian and the technician. Very professional young women.

First experience at this clinic, consultation for my cat with Dr. Papillon. He listened very well and gave excellent advice. He also seemed to understand the realities of pet owners very well!
The prices are very competitive and affordable compared to other veterinary clinics.
Thank you for your feedback!
My local veterinary clinic for several years. I highly recommend it.

What a pleasant experience! My expectations were exceeded across the board!

I found the online appointment system incredibly efficient. Being able to choose your veterinarian, see available dates and times, and then receive a reminder from Mika to review the appointment and provide as much information as possible... so efficient!
No wasted time. When I met the technician, all the information was already there.

When confirming the appointment and receiving the reminder, several very relevant pieces of information were also shared. For example, traffic disruptions in the area, parking information, and the fact that Ontario Street is a pedestrian zone. Wow! That was really helpful. It allowed me to plan my visit effectively, avoid delays, and even incur extra charges.

All the staff were attentive, kind, and caring. In short, a visit that went beyond my expectations!

And what's more, there's follow-up after the visit. It shows that my opinion matters and that their desire to meet their clients' expectations is important.

A truly wonderful experience from start to finish!
I took my timid senior cat to the vet for the first time. The technician and the vet were very skilled at making her comfortable. They both took the time to answer all my questions.
Very professional and respectful, good approach to animals and owners, and only provides the necessary medical care.
Thank you for your feedback!

Exceptional, efficient, and attentive service!
Raphaëlle is a veterinarian I highly recommend.

Excellent service. Absolutely every member of the team, without exception, treated Señor Juan Taquito del Chihuahua perfectly. I love my vet visits, and even he doesn't dread them, which is 100% thanks to the wonderful team. Everything went smoothly, no hitches whatsoever. Five stars at every stage, from the initial reception, which avoids any unpleasant surprises and puts the animals at ease, to check-out, including the visits from the technicians and veterinarians.

I would have loved for the clinic to offer vasectomies, rather than just neutering, as studies support the reduction in anxiety compared to neutering, but the care and follow-up after the operation were perfect.
Thank you for your feedback!
Excellent. Everything was explained to me very clearly. The kindness, friendliness, and patience of the staff made us feel welcome and important. I highly recommend it.

I like this clinic, especially for the excellent care provided by Dr. Lionel Leroy, who always takes the time to explain things thoroughly. The staff is very courteous, and the prices are more affordable than at other clinics.

I'm less keen on the waiting room. I find it poorly laid out; you have to hold your pets securely.
Great! The vet was very patient and attentive without pushing anything.
Excellent, well explained, a passion for animal health

I was very satisfied with the visit for my cat, who is newly registered at this clinic. I don't have the names of everyone present that day except for Dr. Papillon, but everyone was very welcoming. The appointment was on time; the veterinarian explained things very clearly and it was very pleasant to talk to him. The veterinarian I saw a few months ago was also very good.
A recently renovated clinic with very friendly staff. I've been going there for my cat for several years and it's always gone very well!
A very professional team. The receptionists, the technician, and the veterinarian are all competent and caring. They do their jobs professionally. I recommend this clinic without hesitation.

I often take my aging cat, who has several health issues, to this clinic, and the staff is truly kind and competent. (I've seen four different vets, and they were all very friendly and knowledgeable.) The technicians are also particularly kind and sharp. I also greatly appreciate that the clinic is always able to make room for my cat when her condition is more urgent, sometimes at the last minute. The receptionists are very knowledgeable about their work and animals. And finally, the online prescription refill system is really efficient, and I appreciate it.
Thank you for the care you take of my Sophia :)
The staff are very friendly and answer all my questions.
Thank you for taking the time to rate us!
Thank you for your feedback!
Clean clinic with a competent team and affordable prices. My cat is always well treated and the professionals are very empathetic to our problems.

Always attentive and compassionate. They clearly explained the scenarios and the implications of each one. The entire team, from reception when I booked my appointment to the technicians and veterinarians, are top-notch! Compassion, competence, efficiency
A fantastic team (receptionists, technicians, and doctors)! I've been a loyal customer for 15 years and have never been disappointed. Their genuine human touch is much appreciated.

‼️Local service is failing.

[UPDATE: THE EMERGENCY CLINIC IN BROSSARD THAT SURGERYED OUR DOG WAS VERY CLEAR: OUR DOG CAN ABSOLUTELY BE FOLLOWED UP POST-OPERATIVELY AT OUR LOCAL CLINIC IN MONTREAL HOCHELAGA. THIS WAS EVEN ENCOURAGED AND THEY IMMEDIATELY TRANSFERRED THE CASE. A LUNAR RESPONSE UNDER THIS COMMENT.] This confirms what we suspected.

Our dog had to undergo emergency surgery, not at a regular day clinic, for a gastric torsion that occurred during the night of Saturday, July 25th to Sunday, July 26th, 2026. Only an emergency clinic could perform this procedure, and it wasn't out of disloyalty that we had to travel to another clinic, urgently renting a car we didn't own.

The medical secretary's delightful attitude on the phone this Wednesday, July 29, 2026, at 10:00 AM:

"The vet isn't comfortable doing a follow-up here because he wasn't operated on here."

(Except that it's her professional obligation. At what point does a vet refuse to treat an animal regularly seen at their own clinic for a minor emergency, especially after holding the consultation fee by credit card for a same-day appointment before 5:00 PM?)

Is that an answer? Is that how you respond to helpless dog owners facing a medical situation, especially when it's your local, affiliated clinic?

"You can tell your wife to stop shouting!" when my wife was expressing her despair not by shouting, but rather by raising her voice (which is not the same thing) out of sheer despair. Not a peep, not a peep.

They had already made a mistake regarding our dog's rabies vaccination schedule.

So, what do you think:
- lack of empathy
- dereliction of duty
- sheer incompetence

or perhaps
- a selective, selective approach, favoring patients without medical complications because they have too many clients at this clinic and could easily turn some away?

We have two animals that we regularly take to this clinic.

From an ethical standpoint, as a client, how would you interpret the situation and what would you think?

Should we file a complaint and report them?

We have already seen animals die at this clinic because they couldn't even save them in time.

For me, it's pure incompetence and endangering lives. Especially since the emergency clinic in Brossard that operated on our dog advised us and even took the trouble to transfer our dog's file so we could continue follow-up care at our local clinic.
Outrageous! Truly!

At this point, we're better served by Google AI than by HoMa Clinic…

This warrants a complaint to the professional order and a report.

And to think that just yesterday, Tuesday, July 28, 2026, we bought $50 worth of cans of medicated dog food from them.

I expect to read the clinic's own lamentations and other talking points and justifications in response to this comment, as if to try and redeem their poor management.

I highly recommend this clinic. The staff is efficient, attentive, and patient with me at every visit. Dr. Lionel Leroy is an excellent veterinarian who truly cares about animal welfare and doesn't try to charge for unnecessary treatments or tests. He takes the time to explain things thoroughly and answer all questions. All the technicians and receptionists are also incredibly courteous and efficient. The prices are very reasonable. In my opinion, it's the best veterinary clinic in town!

I am very satisfied; the follow-up was excellent, and the explanations were clear. Thank you to my veterinarian, who was patient with my frightened cat, very competent and empathetic, and didn't pressure me to buy additional treatments.
Very professional and attentive. The technician and the veterinarian were very caring. A humane approach.
Excellent service, very comprehensive and compassionate, with relevant details and no inflated billing.

They've been seeing old Pabs for 3 years now and he's never had any issues. They were very trusting and open when it came time to try out different medications and doses for his chronic allergies.
They truly do care about your pet. They are always available to answer the phone for questions and keeping track of his flare ups.  They even ask for news when I come around to get his food and prescription!
I'm so happy they got a chance to renovate and get more building space. They are well intentioned and deserve to be able to continue doing such fair business in Hochelaga.
Excellent vets, attentive, gentle with animals, and often very available. I've been going there for my dogs for several years.

The entire staff at the clinic were incredibly attentive, kind, and professional throughout our dog's life; from his first appointment as a puppy to his last one when we said goodbye 😢
A huge thank you
The humans of Jura
Excellent clinic with kind and caring staff!
Thank you for your feedback!
They cancel appointments without calling. They refuse to honor the 3-year rabies booster vaccination because it was 2 days past the deadline due to their cancellation. A deposit is required.
Excellent veterinary clinic in the area, with helpful staff and fair prices.

They cancelled my appointment via email, which I didn't see. They should notify you when you make the booking. I called, but in less than an hour they had already given my appointment to someone else. The receptionist was very unfriendly; she just said, "That's how it is," and didn't try to find another solution. If they treat you like that on the phone, I don't even want to imagine what it's like in person.

I absolutely do not recommend this clinic. I went there very worried about my cat, hoping to get some answers. Unfortunately, my experience was extremely disappointing. The veterinarian herself told me she didn't know what was causing my cat's problem, but despite this lack of a diagnosis, she kept trying to sell me various products and services.
I felt like a customer they were trying to sell me more to, rather than a pet owner seeking proper care. I left without any clear answers, but with a lot of expensive recommendations.
A frustrating and disappointing experience. I will not be going back.
I do not recommend this veterinarian

We are very disappointed with our recent experience at the clinic. We arrived slightly late due to traffic, and about 15 minutes after our scheduled appointment time, while we were parking, we were informed that we likely wouldn't be seen.

We had tried to book an appointment last week, so we were very much looking forward to this one, as our dog is sick and we had taken the first available slot. We drove for about an hour and a half, in heavy traffic and with roadwork that day, only to end up not seeing a veterinarian or technician. We understand that we were late, but we would have appreciated more flexibility, especially since our dog was sick, weak, and not eating.

Our dog therefore spent several hours in the car without being examined, which caused us a great deal of stress and inconvenience, especially since we had to take time off work for this appointment.

We explained the situation on-site. The receptionist was very empathetic and tried twice to check with the veterinarians and technicians, but unfortunately, no one came to see us. We sincerely thank her for her help.

We would also like to suggest an improvement: when an animal is sick, it might be possible to allocate at least 10 minutes (or the remaining minutes of the appointment slot) to check its general condition, or even a follow-up call the next day, rather than never seeing a technician or veterinarian. This would allow for a more humane service while acknowledging the inconvenience caused by the delay.

This experience has left us very frustrated. We understand the rules, but we felt a complete lack of consideration for our pet's well-being. In this context, if you want a less impersonal and more sensitive service, I do not recommend this clinic. We will be changing clinics for our animals, as this one does not align with our values ​​or the ethics of care.
I do not recommend this veterinarian.

We were very disappointed with our experience. We had made an appointment for our sick dog who wasn't eating/was lethargic. Unfortunately, we were delayed by 30 minutes, which doesn't usually happen, but life sometimes throws curveballs. (1.5 hours in traffic) The receptionist was very kind, but the veterinarian refused to see us without even checking on our dog's condition. When clients arrive worried with a sick animal, a little flexibility would have been appreciated. Adjusting one's schedule slightly shouldn't be a miracle.

We made the trip from Laval for nothing, and unfortunately, we won't be going back.

Thank you to the HoMa clinic for providing such wonderful support during the passing of our cat Cooper and for taking such good care of him on his last day. The staff's communication, competence, and availability were greatly appreciated. Thank you again to the team for being there for our cat and for us 🫶 …

The salesperson quoted me $30, but in the end it was $30 + $120 + other fees.
I will never go back to that place.
Thanks very much
Thank you for rating us!

The staff's kindness and professionalism were incredibly reassuring. They understood the urgency of our dog's situation and took charge quickly. Dr. Ouellette followed up the next morning, and we could feel her compassion. Thank you, Tobby and we!
Thank you for your feedback!

Like everyone else, I shop around for prices. I obviously want to go to a good clinic, but I've noticed there can be a $200 to $300 difference between clinics for the same service. So I simply wanted to know the base price for a dental cleaning for a small dog.

I completely understand that an examination is necessary before an exact price can be given. However, I was only asking for an approximate starting price, or at the very least the cost of the consultation, and they refused to give me any information over the phone.

Personally, I find this a lack of transparency. Like many people, I don't want to be surprised at the checkout without having had any idea of ​​the costs beforehand. I find this way of doing things quite dishonest and disrespectful to customers.

Instead, I was asked to go online to open a file, which is also very inconvenient, especially for seniors or those less comfortable with technology.

It's a shame, because it's the closest clinic to my home, but after this experience, I'm going to go somewhere else.

A competent team, impeccable and friendly service from the receptionists, assistants, and veterinarians alike. I discovered this clinic for my little Chihuahua who had her neutered. They take the time to thoroughly explain the procedure before and after the operation. And the prices are very affordable, almost half the price charged at other clinics. Just one small drawback: parking is very difficult to find.
Stout consulted with them (he'll be back in a few days for his final rest). They are flexible, compassionate, and honest. Their prices are reasonable.

Excellent experience at this veterinary clinic.

A very caring and remarkably professional team, from reception to treatment. Dr. Lionel Leroy is particularly kind, patient, and very clear in his explanations.
Special mention also for the very reasonable prices. I recommend them without hesitation. 👌

Diagnosed my cat as being allergic (with no relevant test), then requested me to buy the most expensive food.
My cat had chronic kidney disease and was left undiagnosed until passing away.
Thank you for reminding me that a diploma doesn’t mean you’re a trust worthy person.
Excellent service always for my Kia 🐱 …
The staff working at this clinic are sociable and professional.
Excellent caring staff!
Thank you for taking the time to rate us. Feel free to share your recommendations with us at info@cvhoma.com :)
Many more appointments available! Congratulations, it's an excellent and affordable neighborhood clinic!

Very satisfied with the services. The team is conscientious and doesn't try to sell unnecessary products. Easy follow-up by phone to adjust medication dosages. The prescription renewal system is very convenient. Return options are available on certain pet foods.
Competent veterinarians, fair prices, and attentive staff who respond quickly to all our questions and concerns. I highly recommend them!

We would like to thank the Homa veterinary clinic for their emergency care. All the staff showed great compassion and kindness towards both our pet and us. Thank you from the bottom of our hearts for your professionalism and empathy. It made all the difference for us.
I love this vet, he's super nice to our little Pouki, gives great advice, and the prices are good.
My cat Romy has an autoimmune disease and she receives excellent care at the Homa clinic. All the staff are respectful, professional, and caring. I highly recommend this clinic for your pets!
This has been my cat's clinic for 5 years. Very good service and reasonable prices, even though veterinary care is still expensive!

Excellent service and a caring, attentive team. From the veterinary technicians and veterinarians to the receptionists, everyone was wonderful. Lucille had some abnormal test results, but the team worked closely with us and took a very humane and empathetic approach. Today, everything is fine, and we felt they listened to us attentively. I highly recommend them!

Excellent clinic!
I regularly take my asthmatic cat there. The assistants provide great care.
I have complete confidence in them.
Thank you for rating us!
Great service and care for my daughter's cat. Merci!
Thank you for your feedback!

A wonderful experience at the clinic! A special thank you to Dr. Ouellette, who was very kind and professional. We were apprehensive, as our Milo is a little timid, but everything went smoothly :) The costs are very reasonable and the service is warm and welcoming!
Personally, I love it... excellent service... the team is truly fantastic... attentive. They took the time to reassure me and answered all my questions. Thank you to the team! 😀 …

I called and no one returned my call.
In short, my little one is now in peace in heaven, but not thanks to you. 😮‍💨 …
Thank you for rating us!
Thank you for your feedback!
Wonderful people that care ❤❤❤

Our beautiful Miro had been a patient at the clinic for several years. We were looking for a smaller, more personal clinic because he was getting older and reacting badly to each of his vet visits. We've always received excellent service over the years, but for us, the Homa team has now gone from excellent to exceptional! You never know when the time will come to say goodbye to your furry friend. For us, it happened this year, on December 24, 2025. At 14 and a half years old, our standard poodle had a crisis; he was in pain and could no longer walk or eat. We had to make a quick and incredibly difficult decision. The Homa team welcomed us on Christmas Eve (!!!) with such gentleness and kindness. We will never forget how they enveloped our sadness in such comforting embrace. Despite the immense loss for our family, we feel great relief that this moment of life was spent with them, for Miro and for us. Thank you so much! ❤️

They saved my cat's life 🙏
Less expensive than other clinics in the area
Thank you to all the staff for your excellent service
See you in the spring for the flea and tick treatment! …
Excellent clinic, really kind and caring team
Thank you for rating us!

We wholeheartedly recommend this clinic, which took excellent care of our last two cats. Thank you to Dr. Leroy and the entire reception and technician team who were so helpful, kind, available, and compassionate. We sometimes go through difficult times with our pets, but we were always very well supported, and we won't forget it.

Since no comments have been left and no records are associated with this name, we are unable to understand the situation described.

If this review is based on an actual experience at the clinic, we encourage you to contact us directly so that the situation can be clarified.
Good place

Since no comments have been left and no records are associated with this name, we are unable to understand the situation described.

If this review is based on an actual experience at the clinic, we encourage you to contact us directly so that the situation can be clarified.
The best! People who are there for the right reasons and who truly care about animals… it's their priority! I applaud their generosity and patience! Something to be proud of ❤️
Very good services, we take our cats here
Thank you for your feedback!

⚠️ Terrible Service and Exorbitant Costs for International Procedures!!!! My recent experience with this clinic has been extremely disappointing, especially considering their prices. I needed to complete all the veterinary procedures for exporting my pets (dog and cat) to France. The process was inefficient from the start: Initial Lack of Competence: During the initial booking, the staff couldn't guide me through the procedure and referred me directly to the CFIA, leaving me to handle most of it myself. Excessive Fees: I had to book four appointments ($90 each) for simple check-ups. On top of that, there was an additional $50 charge for completing the certificate and other fees for updating the records, for a total of approximately $600 in veterinary fees. Excessive Additional Fees: I was charged $50 to trim two of my cat's claws, a cost bordering on extortion considering the consultation fees. Even worse is the final result: the paperwork wasn't properly prepared or organized. At the airport, I discovered that the certificates and vaccination records were misfiled, and the health records hadn't even been updated correctly. It's shameful to offer such shoddy service for a practice charging such high fees. Two years ago, the service was excellent, but since the expansion, it feels like a money-making machine where quality is no longer a priority. I won't be going back!
Prices have more than doubled in two years. The staff is cold and unskillful. Don't get your nails trimmed here; you'll regret it. Almost $45 for a 10-minute trim.
A modern clinic where our furry little companions are pampered! The staff, both attentive and warm, puts you at ease from the moment you arrive. Well done to the whole team!

I usually go there to get food for my little potato. The receptionists are always lovely, and you can even pay remotely. My cat, B, had a sore paw, so I called. They gave me an emergency appointment for the same day, which I unfortunately missed. They managed to get me another one for the next day. Once I arrived... this time, we didn't miss our appointment, phew! My feline was first seen by an assistant who wasn't smiling and was very serious. It stressed my cat and me out a bit. Then Dr. Pierrard arrived, a sweetheart. She took her time asking me questions and giving my baby a little scratch, who at first thought she was at the spa, but eventually realized that all that good Creamy stuff they were giving her wasn't free. Being a good Bengal cat, she started to find the time dragging and the doctor's checking scratches boring. So she darted under the chair as soon as she could. I put her back on the table for her gentle torture, which thankfully didn't last much longer thanks to our kind doctor who understood her perfectly. There was no break, fracture, or sprain. The doctor prescribed pain medication and explained the next steps if things didn't improve. I appreciated that the doctor took her time and used a non-invasive approach. Then the assistant returned, not usually smiling, but this time she had a lovely smile. She explained how to administer the medication patiently, and then we went on our way. I was worried about the final bill, but it was quite reasonable. I highly recommend this clinic after this first visit.

I want to thank the Homa clinic again for many reasons. First, their reception is always impeccable, kind, respectful, and warm. Second, their genuine respect for our animals: gentle handling, no over-medication, and no irrational fear. Third, their respect for family realities. No judgment on our choices, possibilities, or resources, especially since we are respectful and loving towards our animals.

My mother went to this veterinary clinic during an extremely difficult time: her cat was very ill and had no quality of life, and she had made the heartbreaking decision to have him euthanized.

Before the appointment, she clearly explained to the receptionist that she didn't want any tests done, as she couldn't afford the treatments—especially since there was no guarantee her cat would get better. She was told that this was possible.

She also asked not to be present during the euthanasia, as it was too painful for her. She even asked to pay by Interac e-Transfer so she could leave as quickly as possible, which was accepted.

But once she arrived, everything changed. She was told that the $90 test was mandatory, despite her prior refusal. She was forced to attend, and she was even made to pay in the waiting room, next to her dying companion.

Then, despite her distress, they insisted on offering her medication, even though she repeatedly stated that she couldn't afford to spend more—and that she had come precisely to prevent her pet from suffering a prolonged agony.

She finally left in tears, having paid over $300 to have her cat euthanized—more than double the price advertised on their website ($50 to $150). This experience was deeply traumatic, marked by a complete lack of empathy and a feeling of having been financially squeezed.

This kind of treatment is unacceptable at such a vulnerable time. It's a disgrace.

It's been almost two years since the last incident at the Homa Veterinary Clinic, but my anger and sense of injustice are still very much alive.

When I first started going to the Homa Veterinary Clinic, I loved it. It was friendly, welcoming, and unpretentious, and you could feel the staff's genuine love for animals. I remember the ladies at reception who were cheerful and reassuring. I liked it so much that I recommended it to many of my friends.

Then, they renovated, and everything that was wonderful was lost over time. The prices went up, the human touch disappeared, and the receptionists changed.

I took my cat there for almost 14 years. In September 2021, I spent a fortune trying to save him. There were treatments I hadn't even consented to. I bought a machine that I never managed to use. The technicians tried too, but they couldn't get it to work. I couldn't get a refund.

I had to buy expensive medication every month. I would call when it was time to refill the prescription. One time, I called because my cat wasn't feeling well. While I was talking to her, the receptionist was laughing and joking with other people there. I simply asked if she was listening to me. Once I got there, the technician took me aside and told me I had bullied the receptionist. Believe me, I'm the last person who would bully or even raise my voice.

The following month, the same receptionist told me they weren't going to give me any medication because I was due for an appointment with my veterinarian. I mentioned to her that I hadn't seen my original vet three times and that, following surgery, I was struggling financially. So I asked for a one-month extension, especially since I'd had a checkup six months prior for something other than vaccinations. She refused. She started yelling on the phone. She was on speakerphone, and my colleagues were outraged. She even told me I didn't love my cat and that she didn't care about my cat. I asked to speak to my vet or the owner. She refused.

The veterinary board told me it was my right. I called back. She hung up. I went in person. She was nice until I gave her my name. She demanded to see me. I was the one being bullied, but I was the one being bullied. Despite all my efforts, I never spoke to my vet again, and I never managed to speak to a supervisor.

My cat's condition deteriorated after a few months. I called to have him euthanized. I was crying on the phone. The woman was sympathetic. I gave my name. She put me on hold. She came back to tell me to go somewhere else.

I was never rude, and they decided to believe someone who had no witnesses, while I had several.

I love animals. In my neighborhood, I had the stray cats spayed or neutered, and my cat was very important to me. I was about to experience a significant loss, and I was met with cruelty in return, even though I was a very loyal customer.
